steps.step: N1.factorisation: V_1 V_2 V_3 (controlled partial shifts along the cubic axes) equals the eight-step bcc walk sum_eps A_eps T_eps in position space
N2.random U(2) = U(1) x SU(2) links: the gauged walk W_U is unitary and exactly gauge covariant, W_{U^g} = G W_U G^dag
N3.a constant link phase is the flat family-Cartan twist (Part T): the gauged walk on a plane wave is W(k -+ A)

steps.step: N4.minimal coupling: a uniform B along z gives relativistic Landau levels omega_n = sqrt(2nB) (n = 1,2,3) plus a zero level; the lattice deviation shrinks as B -> 0

N5.Nielsen-Ninomiya in gauged form: in the field, one chirality block has chiral n = 0 branches near k_z = 0 (light node) and near k_z = pi/2 (doubler P) with OPPOSITE slopes +-1: the doubler cancels the chiral anomaly, a block-only link couples vectorially
steps.detail: 6 light zero-branch states with slopes [0.98], 6 doubler states with slopes [-0.98]

steps.step: N6.count: matter per family = Lambda^even C^5 = 16 (1 + 10 + 5 of SU(5)), S48 = 3 x 16; Z16 index per family 16 = 0 mod 16: the necessary anomaly condition for a symmetric (chirality-preserving) gap of a doubler copy holds -- condition only (mechanism cited, not tested)

N7.(statement) gauge fields = link variables on the partial shifts: exact covariance, correct continuum coupling (Landau levels); the chiral Standard-Model gauge structure is NOT obtained at the free level (doubler cancels the anomaly); it needs an interacting symmetric gap of the doubler sector (CHIRAL4D.NOMIRROR.01)
